8.39.1. iLock_Geography.xconfig.Geo¶

class iLock_Geography.xconfig.Geo(*args)¶
Return an object holding one of two types of data:
  • The name of a geo predicate.
  • The name of a geo type and the regular expression describing which parts from the geo object name (with the geo type) are used to name the corresponding PiSPEC object.
Special methods that are implemented:
  • __str__.
